copy.headline: Embroidered button-front shirt and column maxi skirt — a two-piece that reads as one line.
copy.description: The Diza Set pairs a relaxed button-front shirt with drop shoulders and a trail of floral embroidery across the chest, over a full-length column skirt that falls to a side slit. Cut in the house's powdery pink and warm cream, it moves from morning flights to evening tables without changing a thing.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs. Floral embroidery is placed by hand on each shirt.

fabric.material: Lightweight woven with embroidered floral detail
fabric.drapeDescription: Fluid column through the skirt; relaxed and airy through the shirt
fabric.finish: Matte weave with burgundy line-floral embroidery
fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.
